verdict.rationale: The evidence covers importing into Cake: bulk spreadsheet upload and guides for exporting data out of Carta and Pulley, which are other vendors' features. Nothing documents Cake's own export of the full cap table or transaction history to Excel/CSV. Docs-36 says a live view means "no spreadsheet export needed", and the read-only MCP access and ESS reporting are adjacent features rather than open-format data export.
